alt: Samsung Bespoke AI side-by-side refrigerator with a glowing 9-inch Family Hub touchscreen displayed in a minimalist kitchen with marble countertops
story: Samsung's Bespoke AI Family Hub side-by-side fridge (reviewed Oct 19, 2026) has a 9-inch touchscreen that has no dark mode, flooding the kitchen at full brightness all night, while the AI that justifies the $3,500+ price tag can only identify 37 fresh foods — and the voice-to-open feature opens both doors at once.
why_funny: Samsung built a refrigerator smart enough to talk to you, but not smart enough to dim its screen at night or know what a carrot is.
